prerequisites.description: Each assigned agent carries a pistol; no brand/model restriction.
Each assigned agent carries a receptacle whose model collects the evidence category; missing-category selection policy remains open.

One shared motor vehicle per Investigation task assignment. Standard vehicle supports teams up to 4; van supports teams up to 6. Staffing limits remain separate. Generic vehicle types are cataloged; runtime capacity enforcement and allocation are not implemented.

openItems.PRE-01: Owned vehicle quantities, runtime capacity enforcement and allocation; generic vehicle types and capacities are authored separately.
openItems.PRE-02: Missing-receptacle behavior for weighted evidence selection.
openItems.PRE-03: Runtime inventory, equipment assignment and eligibility.
